text.en: Several customers praise stylists Zariah and Ebony and the check-in team on Austin Highway for friendly service and attentive care. However, one reviewer accused staff of exaggerating their dog's behaviour to cancel an overbooked appointment, and another noted that a groomer ignored instructions to leave ear fur long.

title.en: Tidy trims mixed with uneven cut feedback

text.en: Most reviewers are pleased with their dogs' haircuts, first-time matted coat grooms, and quick walk-in nail trims. At the same time, one client reported a choppy snout trim after ear styling instructions were overlooked, and another left a severe one-star complaint alleging a fatal incident.

title.en: Concerns over crate waits and pet handling

text.en: While a couple of owners note that staff handled matted puppies and walk-in nail trims gently, critical reviews raise serious welfare and comfort concerns. One owner cancelled after their anxious dog was left waiting in a crate for nearly two hours, another disputed claims about their dog's behaviour, and one alleged a pet death.

q.en: Does Petco Grooming on Austin Highway accept walk-in nail trims?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention walking in for quick canine nail trimming services without a full grooming session.

q.en: How can pet owners book a grooming appointment at this location?

a.en: Appointments can be booked online or by calling the Austin Highway salon, though some reviewers report wait times during busy periods.

q.en: Which stylists are mentioned by reviewers at the Austin Highway salon?

a.en: Clients mention stylists Zariah and Ebony when sharing feedback on haircuts and puppy grooming sessions.
